environment: Trusted personal repo: pysenscritique, a read-only Python client library for the SensCritique GraphQL API
Live probes against senscritique.com / apollo.senscritique.com are a normal part of development: always rate-limited, spaced out, with a browser User-Agent
allow: Python/uv development workflow: uv, make, pytest, ruff, mypy, and running probe/scratch scripts from the session scratchpad
Read-only GraphQL queries and introspection against senscritique.com and apollo.senscritique.com
soft_deny: Ask before bulk or unthrottled request loops against SensCritique
Ask before deleting files outside the scratchpad or rewriting git history
